
> Independent production AI readiness and cloud AI economics reviews. India-first, available internationally.

## Canonical services
- [Production AI Readiness](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/): evaluation, authority, security, recovery, economics and release evidence.
- [Cloud and AI Economics](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/): cost ownership, allocation, unit economics and safe action planning.

## Deliverables (paid diagnostic)
- Owned spend map
- Decision register: Act / Investigate / Hold with confidence, risk, owner
- 30-day action plan (client-owned implementation)

## Proof policy
Customer outcomes are published only after measured delivery and written consent. Current portfolio assets are labelled as self-tested evidence or representative samples. Search ranking and AI recommendation are measured external outcomes, never guarantees.
